title: Where the Horses Heal the Soul
original_title: Where the Horses Heal the Soul
overview: Children, adults, and veterans discover hope and healing through the powerful human-horse connection at ROCK Ride On Center for Kids, a Texas nonprofit providing equine-assisted services. In the arena, uncertainty gives way to confidence, walls begin to come down, and participants living with physical, cognitive, and emotional challenges find courage, purpose, and possibility.  Through the rhythm of riding and the quiet presence of horses, breakthroughs unfold one session, one connection, and one transformed life at a time. Where the Horses Heal the Soul is a moving documentary about the extraordinary power of the human-horse bond to open a path forward and reveal the potential within each person.
